### From Success to Setback
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/from-success-to-setback-greg-laurie-devotion-march-19-2021.html
Passage: Genesis 39:21
Points:
- Joseph faced severe betrayal and false accusations despite fleeing temptation and serving Potiphar with integrity.
- Although he had every earthly reason to despair or feel abandoned, Joseph did not complain against God.
- Scripture emphasizes that the Lord remained present with Joseph in the prison and showed him steadfast love.
- Believers can take comfort knowing that God is actively with them in every difficult setback.

### Imprisoned Again
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/imprisoned-again
Passage: Genesis 39:20
Points:
- God's unseen hand preserved Joseph from execution, moving Potiphar to sentence him to prison instead.
- Experiencing hardship does not mean a person lacks faith, as unjust suffering is often God's path toward blessing.
- Past deliverances helped Joseph trust that the Lord would remain faithful through his current ordeal.
- Believers facing trials can find strength by clinging to God and trusting in His ultimate goodness.
